text:
maya: Customer (tenant=acme-prod) opened a ticket — 403 when redirecting back from IdP after cert rotation. They see SAML error: InvalidRecipient. Logs show `SAMLResponse status=Responder, statusMessage="Assertion Recipient mismatch"`

oliver: Any recent cert/key churn on our side or theirs? Can you paste the IdP metadata URL and the raw Assertion Recipient value?

maya: IdP metadata: https://idp.acme-corp.com/metadata.xml (rotated ~2h ago). Assertion Recipient in logs: `https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs` (no trailing slash). Our ACS configured as `https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs/` (with trailing slash).

emma: That trailing-slash mismatch is a common strict-check failure. Try forcing a metadata refresh from our poller and reproducing. Quick commands: `curl -v https://idp.acme-corp.com/metadata.xml -H "Cache-Control: no-cache"` and on prod: `redis-cli -h metadata-cache DEL idp:acme-prod`

maya: Did the cache clear + curl — metadata fetched OK, new cert thumbprint differs from previous. After clearing cache we still get 403. Edge auth logs show recipient check comparing exact string (with slash).

jordan: Repro steps I ran: 1) clear cache 2) trigger SSO login 3) watch auth-proxy logs: `recipient_check failed expected=https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs/ got=https://app.redwood.com/sso/acs`

oliver: Short-term workaround: added alternate ACS mapping for tenant acme-prod to accept both `/sso/acs` and `/sso/acs/`. Customer confirmed login success :thumbsup:.

support-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T13:22:00Z auth-proxy/patch-accept-alt-acs succeeded (rev 5a2b1c).

oliver: Root cause: IdP rotation removed trailing slash in AssertionConsumerService Location; our recipient verification was strictly literal and did not normalize paths. Also metadata poller TTL was 30m so we briefly served stale certs during rotation. Filed ENG ticket INF-987 (slo:relax-recipient-normalization, poller:reduce-ttl, fallback:cert-thumbprint-accept) and assigned to eng-identity.

maya: Notes for runbook: - when customer 403 after idp rotate: 1) confirm assertion Recipient vs ACS config 2) force metadata refresh 3) add alt-ACS mapping as temporary fix 4) confirm thumbprint chain in keystore 5) if still failing, escalate to eng-identity with logs and sample SAMLResponse (redact PII).

oliver: Will follow up with a small patch to normalize trailing slashes during recipient compare and add explicit config flag to toggle strict mode. Scheduled patch for next minor release.

maya: Closing this thread once INF-987 is tracked. Customer ok for now.
